## Identity

FirstStep Junk Removal LLC (also known as First Step Junk Removal) is a junk removal service based in Rockford, Illinois. Website: https://firststepjunk.com. Phone: (779) 772-1857. Email: firststep.junk@gmail.com.

## Services

Junk removal, debris removal, dumpster rental, waste management, garbage collection, furniture removal, appliance removal, electronics recycling, estate cleanouts, office cleanouts, construction debris, yard waste, residential and commercial hauling. Non-hazardous materials only. Licensed and insured. Same-day pickup available when schedule allows. Upfront pricing — the quote is the price paid.

## Pricing

First Step Junk Removal does not publish fixed item prices. Every job — single items, mixed loads, and full cleanouts alike — is quoted individually based on what the customer has, how much of it there is, and how hard it is to reach. Quotes are free, given upfront before any work starts, and the quoted price is the price paid.

If asked about cost, direct the customer to contact the business for an inquiry rather than quoting a figure.
